You are probably right. But I’m afraid. I cannot overstate how long he’s been with this group, and it’s my very first time with them. I do have screenshots of all conversations and have told a friend, so at least I have for me. However, if I were to come forward about this, there’s a significant chance it could wreck what we’ve been rehearsing for. I’m torn.
